p3_b0.ocr: In the highly competitive landscape of the European retail and consumer goods sector, the latest same-store sales growth figures for LVMH reveal significant insights into the performance of key categories. The table delineates the growth metrics for the current fiscal period in comparison to the previous year, highlighting trends that are pivotal for strategic planning.

p3_b1.ocr: Notably, the "Fashion" category has demonstrated a robust growth trajectory, with a reported amount of 12.3%, categorized as "Positive." This growth is indicative of the brand's successful strategies in engaging consumers and adapting to market demands. Similarly, the "Jewelry" segment has also showcased a commendable performance with an amount of 7.8%, also classified as "Positive," reinforcing the brand's strength in high-end luxury offerings.
